biography.plain_text: Selim Dağbaşı is a Turkish businessman and former shareholder and board member of electrical-equipment manufacturer Viko. The son of industrialist İsmail Ali Dağbaşı, he studied at Near East University. After Panasonic acquired control of Viko, he and his father established Dağbaşı Proje Yatırım ve Ticaret for property investment and development.
biography.html: Selim Dağbaşı is a Turkish businessman and former shareholder and board member of electrical-equipment manufacturer Viko. The son of industrialist İsmail Ali Dağbaşı, he studied at Near East University. After Panasonic acquired control of Viko, he and his father established Dağbaşı Proje Yatırım ve Ticaret for property investment and development.

confidence.reason: Direct interview and company programme account support precise historical attribution; no corporate outcome treated as his sole achievement.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Viko, Selim Dağbaşı argued for restraint when the construction downturn reduced demand for switches and sockets. As commercial coordinator, he linked the problem to excess supply, stalled building sites and delayed projects. The company adjusted its growth plans, wary of expanding too quickly at home or abroad during a crisis.

He also represented Viko in its work with Istanbul schools on energy efficiency. The programme trained teachers, established student energy clubs and used theatre to explain conservation to children. At its awards ceremony, Dağbaşı described responsibility for resources as extending across products, factory operations and waste management.
